entries.en: Don't get it, choom. Been thinkin' and thinkin', but I just don't get it.
entries.ro: Nu pricep, choom. Tot mă gândesc, și tot nu pricep.

entries.en: All that food in the dumpsters. Good food! If they don't want it, why don't they just give it to us?
entries.ro: Toată mâncarea aia din containere. Mâncare bună! Dacă nu o vor, de ce nu ne-o dau pur și simplu?

entries.en: 'Cause they don't even like to think about us. Simple as that.
entries.ro: Pentru că nici nu vor să știe de noi. Asta e.
